name: CryptoBench
description: CryptoBench is a dynamic, expert-curated benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate LLM agents' capabilities in the cryptocurrency domain, focusing on time-sensitive retrieval and predictive analysis tasks.
reputation: A newly introduced expert-curated crypto benchmark from an arXiv preprint, with limited but potentially growing adoption in LLM agent evaluation.
notes: Features a live, dynamic benchmark with monthly updates and categorizes tasks to assess both data gathering and advanced analytical skills.
